summary: Iteration 2. Backend: 59 of 59 pytest tests pass: test_pricing.py, test_luggease_api.py, and a new test_demo_seed.py that checks the demo data and the fixes. All 6 fixes plus the hardening checks were confirmed through the API and UI. The demo data is correct: Priya has 3 orders (DEMO0001/3/5), Ravi sees DEMO0004 with customer contact hidden, admin sees pending partner Amit and DEMO0001-6, and DEMO0001 shows TAX INVOICE LE/DEMO/000001. NEW HIGH bug: on web, reloading or deep-linking to an authenticated screen sends API requests before the stored token has loaded. On /order/:id the resulting 401 deletes the saved token and logs the user out. On /orders the list shows 'Nothing here yet'. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used). No SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: The hosted checkout page used by the native WebView prefills only name and email, not contact (+91XXXXXXXXXX). Fix 6 only covers the web flow, through the /payments/create response. customer_email and name are also inserted into inline JS without JSON-escaping (server.py:865). Use json.dumps.

ui_bugs.issue: Reloading the web page on /order/DEMO0001 or /order/DEMO0004 sends GET /api/orders/{id} with no Authorization header while loadToken() is still pending, and the server returns 401. By the time the response arrives, the module-level token has been loaded, so api() (src/api.ts:34) runs setToken(null) and onUnauthorized(). The stored auth_token is deleted from localStorage and the user is sent back to the login screen. Reproduced for priya (customer) and ravi (partner).

Reloading on /orders fires GET /api/orders 3 times with no token (401 each time) before /auth/me finishes. The query never re-runs after auth loads, and the screen shows the empty state 'Nothing here yet' instead of priya's 3 orders. isError is not handled in app/(tabs)/orders.tsx:30, so the error looks like an empty list.

integration_issues.flow: Cold start / deep link with a saved session
integration_issues.issue: app/_layout.tsx:37 mounts <Stack> (and the route screens' useQuery calls) while auth loading=true. Queries have no enabled:!!user gate.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the auth race. (a) Don't render the Stack screens, or don't let queries run, until auth loading is false. For example, add enabled: !!user to useQuery in orders.tsx, order/[id].tsx and the home components, or render only the spinner while loading. (b) In src/api.ts, capture the token before fetch, e.g. const sent = token, and only clear it on 401 when sent === token, so a request sent without a token can never wipe a newly loaded session. (c) After auth bootstrap or login, call queryClient.invalidateQueries() so screens that already failed fetch again.
MEDIUM: Handle isError in the Orders tab (and other lists) with an error and retry state, instead of showing the empty state.
LOW: Add contact to the prefill on the hosted Razorpay checkout page (server.py:865), and json.dumps the values inserted into the inline script.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 916 lines (more than 700). Consider splitting it into routers: auth, orders, partner, admin, payments, pricing.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI. Use lifespan.
The grand total rounds half up with math.floor(gross + 0.5) on a float sum (server.py:274). Values like x.4999999 could round inconsistently. Consider Decimal.

Verified OK: hide_contact covers both partner open jobs and the detail of an open order the partner hasn't accepted; assign() is atomic (status=paid and partner_id=None filter); /payments/verify is customer-only with an owner check; validators use validationLevel=moderate.

success_rate.frontend: 90%: all requested fixes and demo flows pass; the reload/deep-link auth race fails

To reproduce the auth race: log in on web, open /order/DEMO0001, then page.reload(). The user ends up on the login screen and localStorage auth_token is removed.
rca_of_issue: Repro: log in as priya, open DEMO0001, reload. Network: GET /catalog 200 (no auth), GET /auth/me 200 (with Bearer), GET /orders/DEMO0001 401 (no auth). The order query starts before loadToken() resolves. When its 401 arrives, `token` has been set, so the check `res.status === 401 && token` in src/api.ts:34 clears the valid token and calls onUnauthorized. Mitigation: gate queries on auth readiness, and only clear the token if it is the one that was sent with the failing request.
